_about: Curated career catalogue. The Career guide may only choose from these careers and missions; it never invents careers. 'needs' lists brain concept keys the career builds on (for pathway progress). 'missions' are keys in app/missions.py. 'subjects' is general guidance on useful school subjects, not an admission requirement.

data-scientist.name: Data scientist
data-scientist.about: Finds patterns in data and builds models that make predictions, like filters that catch spam or fraud.
data-scientist.subjects: Mathematics (not Mathematical Literacy). Information Technology helps.

sports-analyst.name: Sports performance analyst
sports-analyst.about: Turns match data into decisions: who takes the penalty, which play works, how a team is improving.

quality-inspector.name: Quality controller
quality-inspector.about: Tests samples from a factory line and predicts how many items in a batch will pass before they ship.

actuary.name: Actuary
actuary.about: Prices risk for insurance and medical aid schemes by working out how likely claims are.
actuary.subjects: Mathematics (not Mathematical Literacy), with strong marks.

epidemiologist.name: Epidemiologist
epidemiologist.about: Tracks how illness spreads in communities and screens for people with overlapping symptoms.

nurse.name: Nurse
nurse.about: Cares for patients and works out safe medicine doses from a patient's weight.
nurse.subjects: Life Sciences. Mathematics or Mathematical Literacy, depending on the programme.

electrician.name: Electrician
electrician.about: Installs and checks wiring, and calculates current and power so circuits stay safe.
electrician.subjects: Mathematics or Technical Mathematics. Physical Sciences helps.

architect.name: Architect
architect.about: Designs buildings and works out angles and lengths so roofs and walls fit together.
architect.subjects: Mathematics. Engineering Graphics and Design helps.

agricultural-scientist.name: Agricultural scientist
agricultural-scientist.about: Helps farms grow more by testing seeds, soil and crops, and predicting harvests.
agricultural-scientist.subjects: Mathematics, Life Sciences or Agricultural Sciences.

meteorologist.name: Meteorologist
meteorologist.about: Forecasts the weather from past records and gives the chance of rain.
